cookie.description: Your LinkedIn session cookie. Accepts: (1) the li_at value from browser DevTools, or (2) full cookies JSON array exported from an extension like EditThisCookie.
cookie.title: LinkedIn Cookie

language.description: Preferred LinkedIn locale for the session (affects headline/text language where applicable).
language.title: Language

maxReactorsPerPost.description: Maximum number of reactors to scrape per post. LinkedIn typically exposes up to 1000.
maxReactorsPerPost.title: Max Reactors Per Post

minDate.description: Only include reactions newer than this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.
minDate.title: Minimum Reaction Date

postUrls.description: LinkedIn post URLs or bare activity IDs. Accepts full post URLs (feed/update/urn:li:activity:... or /posts/...) or plain numeric activity IDs.
postUrls.title: Post URLs or Activity IDs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Residential proxy recommended for best results.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

reactionTypeFilter.description: Only include reactors who gave these reaction types. Leave empty to include all reaction types.
reactionTypeFilter.title: Reaction Type Filter

reactionTypes.description: Alternative multi-select filter using LinkedIn's raw API reaction codes. Leave empty to include all.
reactionTypes.title: Reaction Types (raw API codes)
